00558a1a5fb5.en: Here is the Job once more, written in a new language: the lambda core, which this part builds. It has functions, lists and pairs, and nothing else worth mentioning. <bookmark mark='a'/> Notice what is missing. There is not one type annotation. bump adds one to a word's count in the table, count runs over all the words, and job puts the pieces together. <bookmark mark='b'/> Yet the compiler knows the type of every function. It worked them out by itself, in a few hundred tiny steps. <bookmark mark='c'/> And some of these types contain a variable, written tick a. bump works for words, but it would work just as well for numbers, or for anything that can be compared for equality. The machine discovered that too.
00558a1a5fb5.zh: 这又是任务，用一种新语言写成：λ-核心，这一部分要搭建的语言。它有函数、列表和序对，其余的不值一提。<bookmark mark='a'/>注意少了什么。没有一个类型标注。bump 把表里一个单词的计数加一，count 遍历所有单词，job 把各部分组合起来。<bookmark mark='b'/>可是编译器知道每个函数的类型。它自己推出了它们，用了几百个微小的步骤。<bookmark mark='c'/>其中有些类型含有一个变量，写作 'a。bump 适用于单词，但也同样适用于数字，或者任何能比较相等的东西。这一点机器也发现了。

f81045e80f67.en: And underneath the lambda core there is something even smaller. <bookmark mark='a'/> Here is two plus three, written with functions and nothing else: no numbers, no addition, only functions applied to functions. <bookmark mark='b'/> One rule, applied again and again, rewrites it, <bookmark mark='c'/> until it stops. And the result is the number five, or rather, a function that applies f to x five times. Alonzo Church found in the nineteen thirties that this one rule is enough to compute anything that can be computed. Part 1 met his lambda calculus; this part takes it seriously.
f81045e80f67.zh: 在 λ-核心之下，还有更小的东西。<bookmark mark='a'/>这是二加三，只用函数写成：没有数字，没有加法，只有函数作用于函数。<bookmark mark='b'/>一条规则，一遍又一遍地应用，改写它，<bookmark mark='c'/>直到它停下。结果是数字五，或者说，一个把 f 作用于 x 五次的函数。阿隆佐·丘奇在二十世纪三十年代发现，这一条规则足以计算一切可计算的东西。第1部分见过他的 λ 演算；这一部分要认真对待它。

a5b90584688d.en: Here is the route through the lesson. <bookmark mark='a'/> Build numbers, booleans, lists and recursion from functions in the pure untyped calculus. <bookmark mark='b'/> Compare full reduction with weak evaluation: strategies can differ in termination and cost, while beta normal forms remain unique when they exist. <bookmark mark='c'/> Add a specific simple type system and prove progress and preservation for its closed programs. <bookmark mark='d'/> Infer principal types in a small ML core, then examine which richer features change those guarantees. <bookmark mark='e'/> Finally, read types as propositions and terms as evidence in a stated logical calculus. Keeping the model visible lets these connections explain one another without promising the same theorem for every programming language.
a5b90584688d.zh: 这一课按这条路线展开。<bookmark mark='a'/>在纯无类型演算中，用函数搭建数字、布尔值、列表和递归。<bookmark mark='b'/>比较完全归约与弱求值：策略的终止性和代价可能不同，而 β 范式若存在则唯一。<bookmark mark='c'/>加入明确的简单类型系统，为其中的封闭程序证明进展性与保持性。<bookmark mark='d'/>在小型 ML 核心中推断主类型，再研究哪些丰富特性会改变保证。<bookmark mark='e'/>最后，在规定的逻辑演算中，把类型读作命题，把项读作证据。始终写明模型，才能让这些联系相互解释，而不是为所有编程语言承诺同一定理。

6fca0ec71808.en: This is Part 14 of Computer Science, Built, in Act Three, Speaking to the Machine. <bookmark mark='a'/> In this part: lambda terms, substitution and beta reduction. Church encodings, and the Y combinator. Evaluation strategies, and the Church Rosser theorem. Simple types, the safety theorems, and normalization. Hindley Milner inference, System F and free theorems. And the Curry Howard correspondence, with dependent, linear and gradual types.
6fca0ec71808.zh: 这是《计算机科学，从零搭建》的第14部分，属于第三幕“和机器对话”。<bookmark mark='a'/>这一部分讲：λ 项、代换和 β 归约。丘奇编码，以及 Y 组合子。求值策略，以及丘奇–罗瑟定理。简单类型、安全性定理和正规化。欣德利–米尔纳推断、System F 和免费定理。还有柯里–霍华德对应，以及依赖类型、线性类型和渐进类型。

d041d3bc40d2.en: Chapter one. Terms, variables and substitution.

5ddab8953970.en: The untyped lambda calculus has three term constructors. <bookmark mark='a'/> A variable; an abstraction, lambda x dot t, binding x in its body; and an application, one term applied to another. <bookmark mark='b'/> Read the example's parentheses carefully. The left function is lambda x, x x. Its single argument is the whole application of lambda y, y to z. The syntax tree makes that grouping explicit, with at signs for applications. <bookmark mark='c'/> Application normally associates to the left: f a b means the result of f a applied to b. A lambda body extends rightward until a closing delimiter. Parentheses override those conventions. The tree, rather than an ambiguous spoken string, determines what substitution will copy.
5ddab8953970.zh: 无类型 λ 演算有三种项构造子。<bookmark mark='a'/>变量；抽象 λx.t，在函数体中绑定 x；还有应用，把一个项作用于另一个项。<bookmark mark='b'/>仔细看例子的括号。左边函数是 λx.xx；它唯一的实参，是 λy.y 作用于 z 的整个应用。语法树用 @ 表示应用，把这个分组明确画出来。<bookmark mark='c'/>应用默认向左结合，f a b 表示先得到 f a，再作用于 b。λ 的函数体向右延伸，直到闭合分隔符；括号可以覆盖这些约定。决定代换会复制什么的是树，而不是可能有歧义的口头读法。

9bab69c76e4d.en: Variables come in two kinds. <bookmark mark='a'/> In lambda x, f x y, the x is bound: it refers to the lambda that introduced it, like a function's parameter. <bookmark mark='b'/> f and y are free. They refer to something outside the term, and the term's meaning depends on what they turn out to be. <bookmark mark='c'/> A bound variable's name does not matter. Lambda x, x and lambda y, y are the same function, the identity, and terms that differ only in bound names are called alpha equivalent, just as the integral of f of x d x is the integral of f of t d t.
9bab69c76e4d.zh: 变量分两种。<bookmark mark='a'/>在 λx. f x y 中，x 是约束的：它指向引入它的那个 λ，就像函数的参数。<bookmark mark='b'/>f 和 y 是自由的。它们指向项之外的东西，项的含义取决于它们最终是什么。<bookmark mark='c'/>约束变量叫什么名字无关紧要。λx. x 和 λy. y 是同一个函数，恒等函数；只在约束变量名上不同的项叫作 α 等价，正如 f(x) 对 x 的积分就是 f(t) 对 t 的积分。

36cdd965edde.en: Computation in the lambda calculus is substitution: to apply a function, replace its parameter by the argument. That is subtler than it looks. <bookmark mark='a'/> Take lambda x, lambda y, x: a function that takes two arguments and returns the first. Apply it to a free variable y. <bookmark mark='b'/> Replacing x by y naively gives lambda y, y: the identity function. The free y has been captured by the inner lambda, and the meaning has changed. <bookmark mark='c'/> The correct answer renames the bound y first, to y prime, and gives lambda y prime, y: still a function that ignores its argument and returns y. <bookmark mark='d'/> Capture-avoiding substitution is defined by these rules, and the last one carries the condition. Getting this right is the first bug every implementer of a programming language meets, and the reason closures exist, as Part 15 will show.
36cdd965edde.zh: λ 演算里的计算就是代换：要应用一个函数，就用实参替换它的参数。这比看上去微妙。<bookmark mark='a'/>拿 λx. λy. x 来说：一个接受两个参数、返回第一个的函数。把它作用于一个自由变量 y。<bookmark mark='b'/>天真地用 y 替换 x，得到 λy. y：恒等函数。自由的 y 被内层的 λ 捕获了，含义变了。<bookmark mark='c'/>正确的答案是先把约束的 y 改名为 y'，得到 λy'. y：仍然是一个忽略参数、返回 y 的函数。<bookmark mark='d'/>避免捕获的代换由这些规则定义，条件就在最后一条里。把它弄对，是每个编程语言实现者遇到的第一个错误，也是闭包存在的原因，第15部分会讲到。

2153548b04ba.en: Chapter two. Reduction and normal forms.

1447eab519a7.en: The calculus computes with a single rule, called beta reduction. <bookmark mark='a'/> Wherever a lambda is applied to an argument, the pair is a redex, a reducible expression. <bookmark mark='b'/> Replace it by the function's body, with the argument substituted for the parameter. <bookmark mark='c'/> A redex can sit anywhere inside a larger term, even inside the body of another lambda, and any redex may be reduced at any time. <bookmark mark='d'/> Lambda x, x x applied to z becomes z z. That is all there is.
1447eab519a7.zh: 这个演算只用一条规则计算，叫作 β 归约。<bookmark mark='a'/>凡是一个 λ 作用于一个实参，这一对就是一个可约式。<bookmark mark='b'/>把它替换成函数体，并用实参代换参数。<bookmark mark='c'/>可约式可以出现在更大的项里的任何位置，甚至在另一个 λ 的函数体内，而任何可约式都可以在任何时候归约。<bookmark mark='d'/>λx. x x 作用于 z，变成 z z。就这么多。

080c1f539716.en: Here is a step on the tree. <bookmark mark='a'/> The whole term is a redex: lambda x, x x, applied to an argument that is itself a redex. <bookmark mark='b'/> Reducing the outer one substitutes the argument for both occurrences of x. The argument has been copied, and its redex with it: now there are two. <bookmark mark='c'/> Reduce the first copy, and one remains. This copying is the source of most of what follows: of the cost differences between strategies, and of the reasons a compiler shares work instead of repeating it.
080c1f539716.zh: 这是树上的一步。<bookmark mark='a'/>整个项是一个可约式：λx. x x，作用于一个本身也是可约式的实参。<bookmark mark='b'/>归约外层的那个，把实参代入 x 的两处出现。实参被复制了，连同它的可约式：现在有两个。<bookmark mark='c'/>归约第一个副本，还剩一个。这种复制是后面大部分内容的根源：各种策略之间代价的差别，以及编译器为什么要共享工作而不是重复它。

fe6e1c2ecc6d.en: Here is two plus three again, slowly. <bookmark mark='a'/> A numeral n is the function that applies f to x n times, and plus takes m and n and applies f m times on top of n applications. <bookmark mark='b'/> Each line reduces the redex shown in yellow. First plus swallows its arguments, one at a time. Then three is applied to f and x, and expands into three applications of f, and two adds two more on the outside. <bookmark mark='c'/> The last line has no redex left. It is a normal form: the answer, five applications of f.
fe6e1c2ecc6d.zh: 再看一遍二加三，慢一点。<bookmark mark='a'/>数 n 是把 f 作用于 x n 次的函数，而 plus 接受 m 和 n，在 n 次应用之上再作用 f m 次。<bookmark mark='b'/>每一行归约黄色标出的可约式。先是 plus 一个一个吞下它的参数。然后三作用于 f 和 x，展开成三次 f 的应用，二又在外面加上两次。<bookmark mark='c'/>最后一行没有可约式了。它是一个范式：答案，f 的五次应用。

5e1b5a37b32f.en: Not every term has a normal form. <bookmark mark='a'/> Omega applies lambda x, x x to itself. <bookmark mark='b'/> One step of beta reduction gives back exactly the same term, and the next step the same again, forever. Omega has no normal form: it is the lambda calculus's infinite loop. <bookmark mark='c'/> Worse, some terms have a normal form along one path and loop along another. Here is a function that ignores its first argument, applied to omega and to z. <bookmark mark='d'/> Reduce the outside first and the answer is z, in two steps. Insist on reducing omega first, and you never finish. <bookmark mark='e'/> So the order of reduction matters. Chapter five studies it.
5e1b5a37b32f.zh: 并不是每个项都有范式。<bookmark mark='a'/>Ω 把 λx. x x 作用于它自己。<bookmark mark='b'/>一步 β 归约得到的恰好是同一个项，下一步还是一样，永远如此。Ω 没有范式：它是 λ 演算的死循环。<bookmark mark='c'/>更糟的是，有些项沿一条路径有范式，沿另一条却会无限循环。这是一个忽略第一个参数的函数，作用于 Ω 和 z。<bookmark mark='d'/>先归约外层，答案是 z，两步。坚持先归约 Ω，就永远结束不了。<bookmark mark='e'/>所以归约的顺序很重要。第五章会研究它。

f4834374d00a.zh: 第三章。无中生有的编程。

3bf5494fccfe.en: If the language has nothing but functions, then data must be functions too. Church showed how. <bookmark mark='a'/> A boolean is a choice between two things. True takes two arguments and returns the first; false returns the second. <bookmark mark='b'/> Then if b then x else y needs no special rule at all: it is just b applied to x and y. <bookmark mark='c'/> And p and q is p applied to q and p: if p is true it chooses q, and if p is false it chooses p, which is false. Or is the mirror image. <bookmark mark='d'/> Our reducer confirms all four rows of each table, in four steps each, and every answer comes out as the function true or the function false itself.
3bf5494fccfe.zh: 如果语言里只有函数，那么数据也必须是函数。丘奇展示了怎么做。<bookmark mark='a'/>布尔值是在两个东西之间的选择。true 接受两个参数，返回第一个；false 返回第二个。<bookmark mark='b'/>于是 if b then x else y 根本不需要特殊规则：它就是 b 作用于 x 和 y。<bookmark mark='c'/>p and q 是 p 作用于 q 和 p：如果 p 为真，它选 q；如果 p 为假，它选 p，也就是假。or 是它的镜像。<bookmark mark='d'/>我们的归约器验证了每张表的全部四行，每行四步，每个答案都正是函数 true 或函数 false 本身。

f89e738b2764.en: Numbers are repetitions. <bookmark mark='a'/> The numeral n is the function that takes f and x and applies f to x, n times. Zero applies it no times and returns x. One applies f once. Two wraps x in two applications of f, and so on: picture each f as a box around the one inside. <bookmark mark='b'/> Successor takes a numeral n, lets it apply f n times, and then applies f once more, on the outside.
f89e738b2764.zh: 数字就是重复。<bookmark mark='a'/>数 n 是接受 f 和 x、把 f 作用于 x n 次的函数。零一次也不作用，返回 x。一作用一次。二把 x 包在两次 f 的应用里，依此类推：把每个 f 想象成套在里面那个外面的一个盒子。<bookmark mark='b'/>后继接受一个数 n，让它把 f 作用 n 次，然后在外面再作用一次。

53f7b26e71cc.en: With repetition, arithmetic falls out. <bookmark mark='a'/> Plus m n applies f m more times on top of n applications. <bookmark mark='b'/> Times m n takes the function apply f n times, and repeats that m times. <bookmark mark='c'/> And power is the strangest and shortest of all: n applied to m. Apply the function times m, n times over, starting from one. <bookmark mark='d'/> Our reducer computes three plus four, three times four and two to the third, in six, nine and sixteen beta steps, and each normal form is exactly the expected numeral.
53f7b26e71cc.zh: 有了重复，算术自然就出来了。<bookmark mark='a'/>plus m n 在 n 次应用之上再作用 f m 次。<bookmark mark='b'/>times m n 拿“把 f 作用 n 次”这个函数，把它重复 m 次。<bookmark mark='c'/>而幂是最奇怪也最短的：n 作用于 m。把“乘以 m”这个函数作用 n 次，从一开始。<bookmark mark='d'/>我们的归约器计算三加四、三乘四和二的三次方，分别用六步、九步和十六步 β 归约，每个范式都恰好是预期的数。

b5e29a7ed1f2.en: Pairs encode two values behind a selector. <bookmark mark='a'/> First applies the pair to true; second applies it to false. These are functions selecting one component. <bookmark mark='b'/> For predecessor, counting forward is easier than undoing a function application. Kleene's construction carries two consecutive counts. <bookmark mark='c'/> Start at zero, zero, and update a, b to b, successor b, once per input iteration. For a positive numeral n the first component ends at n minus one. At zero it stays zero, so predecessor saturates rather than producing a negative numeral. <bookmark mark='d'/> Our full normal-order reducer uses nine beta steps for zero, then ten n plus six for the displayed positive numerals. Those counts belong to this encoding and reduction strategy. They count beta contractions, not the cost of copying syntax trees, memory allocation or machine time.
b5e29a7ed1f2.zh: 序对把两个值放在选择器后面。<bookmark mark='a'/>取第一项把序对作用于 true；取第二项作用于 false。这些函数选择其中一个分量。<bookmark mark='b'/>求前驱时，向前计数比撤销函数应用容易。克莱尼的构造保存两个相邻计数。<bookmark mark='c'/>从零、零开始，每次输入迭代把 a、b 更新为 b、b 的后继。对正数 n，第一个分量最后是 n 减一；输入零时，它仍是零。因此前驱会饱和，不会产生负的丘奇数。<bookmark mark='d'/>本例的完全正规序归约器，对零使用九次 β 归约；屏幕上的正数使用十乘 n 再加六次。这些计数属于此编码与归约策略，统计 β 收缩次数，不包括复制语法树、分配内存或机器时间的代价。

46bc99e0712a.en: Lists follow the same pattern. <bookmark mark='a'/> A list is a function of two arguments, c and n. The empty list returns n. A list with head h and tail t applies c to h and to whatever the tail produces. So the list one, two, three is c one, c two, c three, n. <bookmark mark='b'/> A list is its own loop: hand it addition for c and zero for n, and it sums itself. The same idea made the numerals work: a data structure is defined by what you can do with it. <bookmark mark='c'/> Booleans, numbers, pairs and lists, built from lambda, variables and application, and nothing else.
46bc99e0712a.zh: 列表遵循同样的模式。<bookmark mark='a'/>列表是一个有两个参数 c 和 n 的函数。空列表返回 n。头为 h、尾为 t 的列表把 c 作用于 h 和尾部产生的东西。所以列表 1, 2, 3 就是 c 1 (c 2 (c 3 n))。<bookmark mark='b'/>列表就是它自己的循环：把加法作为 c、零作为 n 交给它，它就把自己加起来了。让数字成立的也是同一个思想：一个数据结构由你能对它做什么来定义。<bookmark mark='c'/>布尔值、数字、序对和列表，全部由 λ、变量和应用搭建，别无他物。

db398bcaed72.zh: 第四章。没有名字的递归。

57c3e214c705.en: How can a function call itself, when functions have no names? <bookmark mark='a'/> We would like to define factorial: one if n is zero, and otherwise n times factorial of n minus one. <bookmark mark='b'/> But in the lambda calculus there is no way to write the name fact inside its own definition. <bookmark mark='c'/> So make the recursive call a parameter. F takes a function, self, and returns a factorial that calls self for the smaller case. F is an ordinary lambda term. <bookmark mark='d'/> What we want is a function fact such that F applied to fact is fact again. In the language of mathematics, fact is a fixed point of F. All we need is a way to find fixed points.
57c3e214c705.zh: 函数没有名字，它怎么调用自己？<bookmark mark='a'/>我们想定义阶乘：n 为零时是一，否则是 n 乘以 n 减一的阶乘。<bookmark mark='b'/>可是在 λ 演算里，没有办法在 fact 自己的定义里写出名字 fact。<bookmark mark='c'/>所以把递归调用变成一个参数。F 接受一个函数 self，返回一个在较小情形下调用 self 的阶乘。F 是一个普通的 λ 项。<bookmark mark='d'/>我们要的是这样一个函数 fact：F 作用于 fact 之后还是 fact。用数学的语言说，fact 是 F 的不动点。我们只需要一种找不动点的办法。

63c8adc11fa2.en: Haskell Curry's Y combinator finds them. <bookmark mark='a'/> Y takes f and applies lambda x, f of x x, to itself. <bookmark mark='b'/> Watch it run on some g. One step substitutes g. <bookmark mark='c'/> The next applies the self-application, and out comes g, applied to the very term we had a moment ago. <bookmark mark='d'/> So Y g reduces to g of something that is itself equal to Y g. Y g is a fixed point of g, for every g. <bookmark mark='e'/> Look closely and it is omega again: the same self-application that looped forever, with g wrapped around each copy, so each turn of the loop hands g one more chance to use itself.
63c8adc11fa2.zh: 哈斯凯尔·柯里的 Y 组合子能找到它们。<bookmark mark='a'/>Y 接受 f，把 λx. f (x x) 作用于它自己。<bookmark mark='b'/>看它在某个 g 上运行。一步代入 g。<bookmark mark='c'/>下一步进行自作用，出来的是 g，作用于我们刚才那个项。<bookmark mark='d'/>所以 Y g 归约成 g 作用于某个本身等于 Y g 的东西。Y g 是 g 的不动点，对每个 g 都成立。<bookmark mark='e'/>仔细看，它又是 Ω：同样那个无限循环的自作用，只是每个副本外面都包了一层 g，所以循环每转一圈，g 就多一次使用自己的机会。

17004ca13f45.en: Now combine everything so far. <bookmark mark='a'/> With Church numerals, booleans, multiplication and Kleene's predecessor, F is an ordinary term, and Y F is factorial. Our reducer evaluates it for n from zero to four, and the answers are one, one, two, six and twenty-four. <bookmark mark='b'/> Recursion, from functions that have no names. <bookmark mark='c'/> But look at the cost. Four factorial takes over ten thousand steps, and each extra n multiplies the work. Normal order copies arguments before evaluating them, and then evaluates each copy separately. The next chapter is about exactly this.
17004ca13f45.zh: 现在把目前的一切组合起来。<bookmark mark='a'/>有了丘奇数、布尔值、乘法和克莱尼的前驱，F 是一个普通的项，而 Y F 就是阶乘。我们的归约器对 n 从零到四求值，答案是一、一、二、六和二十四。<bookmark mark='b'/>递归，来自没有名字的函数。<bookmark mark='c'/>但看看代价。四的阶乘要一万多步，n 每多一，工作量就成倍增长。正规序在求值之前复制实参，然后分别求值每个副本。下一章讲的正是这个。

2db71d684adc.en: A fixed-point equation and an evaluation strategy are different questions. <bookmark mark='a'/> With call-by-value, Y F unfolds its self-application before F can use it. This prevents even obtaining the function closure in the displayed example. <bookmark mark='b'/> Z delays that self-application beneath a lambda. Our first comparison tests Y F and Z F only to weak head: constructing Z F returns a closure. Computing a factorial result needs another condition: in a strict language, Church conditionals must delay their branches, or the recursive branch is evaluated even in the zero case. Z alone does not make every recursive program terminate. <bookmark mark='c'/> In the untyped calculus every term has a fixed point up to beta equality. Related computability ideas lead to Kleene's recursion theorem, developed in Part 25. A program that prints its own source is one application, with a specified encoding and output mechanism; it is not the whole theorem.
2db71d684adc.zh: 不动点方程与求值策略是两个问题。<bookmark mark='a'/>传值求值时，Y F 会在 F 能使用自身应用之前，不断展开它。本例甚至无法先得到函数闭包。<bookmark mark='b'/>Z 把自身应用延迟到 λ 下面。第一个比较只把 Y F 和 Z F 求到弱头形式：构造 Z F 会返回闭包。要算出阶乘结果，还需要另一个条件：在严格语言中，丘奇条件式必须延迟两个分支，否则即使零的情形也会先求值递归分支。单靠 Z，不会让任意递归程序终止。<bookmark mark='c'/>在无类型演算中，每个项在 β 等价意义下都有不动点。相关的可计算性思想通向克莱尼递归定理，第二十五部分将展开讨论。打印自身源代码是在明确编码和输出机制下的一种应用，不是整个定理。

75cc1ddb5879.en: Reduction strategies choose which work to perform. <bookmark mark='a'/> Full normal order chooses the leftmost outermost redex, including redexes under lambdas. <bookmark mark='b'/> Full applicative order chooses the leftmost innermost redex, again including lambda bodies. <bookmark mark='c'/> Weak evaluation stops beneath an unapplied lambda. Call-by-name passes the argument unevaluated and can substitute or revisit it each time it is used. Our comparison uses this pure weak model. <bookmark mark='d'/> Call-by-value evaluates an argument to a value before beta application. Many languages use a form of this rule; their sequencing and effects add language-specific details. <bookmark mark='e'/> Call-by-need adds sharing: a suspended argument is evaluated when demanded and its result is reused. This is a model for lazy implementations such as Haskell, with separate costs for allocation, forcing and retaining thunks. Weak-head results and full beta normal forms are different stopping criteria.
75cc1ddb5879.zh: 归约策略决定先做哪些工作。<bookmark mark='a'/>完全正规序选最左最外可约式，也包括 λ 内部。<bookmark mark='b'/>完全应用序选最左最内可约式，同样包括 λ 函数体。<bookmark mark='c'/>弱求值不会进入尚未应用的 λ。传名把实参保持为未求值状态，每次使用可能再次代换或计算。本例比较使用这种纯粹的弱求值模型。<bookmark mark='d'/>传值在 β 应用前，先把实参求成值。很多语言采用这种规则的某个版本，但求值顺序和副作用还有各自的细节。<bookmark mark='e'/>传需加入共享：挂起的实参在需要时求值，之后复用结果。它为 Haskell 一类惰性实现建模，但分配、强制求值和保留悬挂计算各有代价。弱头结果与完全 β 范式，是不同的停止标准。

59c62483fa97.en: Here is the term from chapter two: a function that returns its first argument, applied to a and to omega. <bookmark mark='a'/> Normal order and call-by-name reduce the outside first, and finish in two steps with the answer a. Applicative order and call-by-value insist on evaluating omega before the call, and never finish. <bookmark mark='b'/> The function did not even need omega. Strategies that wait never do worse at finding an answer, which the end of this chapter makes precise.
59c62483fa97.zh: 这是第二章的那个项：一个返回第一个参数的函数，作用于 a 和 Ω。<bookmark mark='a'/>正规序和传名调用先归约外层，两步结束，答案是 a。应用序和传值调用坚持在调用之前求值 Ω，永远结束不了。<bookmark mark='b'/>那个函数根本不需要 Ω。会等待的策略在寻找答案上从不更差，本章最后会把这一点说清楚。

b5761c7552f4.en: Strategies also differ in cost. <bookmark mark='a'/> We ran three functions on the same argument, three times three, on a machine that counts beta steps. <bookmark mark='b'/> When the body uses its parameter three times, call-by-name evaluates the argument three times over: forty-three steps against thirty-three. <bookmark mark='c'/> When the body never uses it, call-by-value evaluates it anyway, and loses. <bookmark mark='d'/> Call-by-need wins both ways: it evaluates an argument at most once, and only if it is needed. Christopher Wadsworth described this sharing in 1971, and it is how Haskell runs.
b5761c7552f4.zh: 策略在代价上也不同。<bookmark mark='a'/>我们在一台计数 β 步数的机器上，用同一个实参，三乘三，运行三个函数。<bookmark mark='b'/>当函数体使用参数三次时，传名调用把实参求值了三遍：四十三步对三十三步。<bookmark mark='c'/>当函数体根本不用它时，传值调用照样求值，就输了。<bookmark mark='d'/>传需调用两头都赢：它至多求值一次实参，而且只在需要时求值。克里斯托弗·沃兹沃思在 1971 年描述了这种共享，Haskell 就是这样运行的。

8cd0e7c56a82.en: One theorem settles which strategy is safest. <bookmark mark='a'/> If a term has a normal form at all, normal order will reach it. Curry and Feys proved this standardization theorem in 1958. <bookmark mark='b'/> So normal order never misses an answer that exists. It may waste work, and real languages mostly choose call-by-value for speed and predictability, accepting that some programs loop that need not. <bookmark mark='c'/> But could two strategies find different answers? That is the subject of the next chapter.
8cd0e7c56a82.zh: 有一条定理裁定了哪种策略最安全。<bookmark mark='a'/>如果一个项有范式，正规序就一定能到达它。柯里和费斯在 1958 年证明了这条标准化定理。<bookmark mark='b'/>所以正规序从不错过存在的答案。它可能浪费工作，而真实的语言大多为了速度和可预测性选择传值调用，接受有些本不必循环的程序会循环。<bookmark mark='c'/>但两种策略会不会找到不同的答案？那是下一章的主题。

d90f2927eaa6.en: Chapter six. Church Rosser, and de Bruijn.
d90f2927eaa6.zh: 第六章。丘奇–罗瑟，以及德布鲁因。

3f93cdd5597d.en: Compare all reductions of this precisely parenthesized term. <bookmark mark='a'/> Lambda x, x x is applied to the whole argument consisting of the identity applied to z. There are two redexes initially. Reducing the outer one copies the argument; reducing the inner one first avoids that duplication. The computed graph identifies terms up to renaming bound variables. <bookmark mark='b'/> It has six nodes and seven reduction edges. This finite graph is fully explored, and every maximal reduction path reaches z z. That exact example illustrates confluence. The general theorem also covers terms with infinite paths; it does not say that every path in every lambda term terminates.
3f93cdd5597d.zh: 比较这个括号明确的项的所有归约。<bookmark mark='a'/>λx.xx 的整个实参，是恒等函数作用于 z 的应用。最初有两个可约式。先归约外层会复制实参；先归约内层则避免这次复制。计算图把只差约束变量改名的项视为同一个结点。<bookmark mark='b'/>图有六个结点、七条归约边。这个有限图已完整探索，每条极大归约路径都到达 z z。精确的小例子说明了合流性。一般定理也涵盖存在无限路径的项，并不声称每个 λ 项的每条路径都会终止。

522ee9ec850f.en: Church and Rosser's theorem concerns beta reduction in the pure calculus. <bookmark mark='a'/> If M reduces by zero or more steps to N one and N two, some P is reachable from both. The four sides of this diamond are reduction sequences, not necessarily single steps. <bookmark mark='b'/> Thus a beta normal form, if one exists, is unique up to renaming bound variables. This does not guarantee termination, and two weak evaluators can stop at different lambda bodies that are still beta equivalent. Effects or additional rewrite rules need their own confluence argument. <bookmark mark='c'/> Ordinary one-step beta reduction lacks the diamond property because a contracted redex can copy another redex. The formal parallel-reduction relation permits coordinated contraction with substitution; it has the joining property used to establish confluence. It is a proof device, not a claim that arbitrary overlapping edits can be performed independently.
522ee9ec850f.zh: 丘奇–罗瑟定理讨论纯演算中的 β 归约。<bookmark mark='a'/>如果 M 经过零步或多步，分别到达 N 一和 N 二，那么两者都能到达某个 P。菱形的四边是归约序列，不一定各走一步。<bookmark mark='b'/>所以 β 范式若存在，在约束变量改名意义下唯一。这不保证终止；两个弱求值器也可能停在不同的 λ 函数体，而它们仍然 β 等价。副作用或额外重写规则，需要各自的合流性论证。<bookmark mark='c'/>普通单步 β 归约没有菱形性质，因为收缩一个可约式可能复制另一个。形式化的平行归约关系，把收缩与代换协调起来，具有证明合流性所需的汇合性质。这是证明工具，不表示任意重叠修改都能相互独立地完成。

44ece8002849.en: A slightly bigger term already has a large graph of possible reductions. <bookmark mark='a'/> This one has thirty terms connected by ninety-three single steps. <bookmark mark='b'/> Our reducer checks every pair of terms in the graph: each pair has a common reduct, and there is exactly one normal form. The theorem, confirmed on a small example.
44ece8002849.zh: 稍大一点的项就已经有一张很大的归约图。<bookmark mark='a'/>这个项有三十个项，由九十三个单步相连。<bookmark mark='b'/>我们的归约器检查了图中的每一对项：每一对都有公共的归约结果，而且恰好有一个范式。这条定理，在一个小例子上得到了验证。

0b091b5a401b.en: De Bruijn indices remove bound-variable names. <bookmark mark='a'/> Zero refers to the nearest enclosing binder, one to the next, and so on. Lambda x, x becomes lambda, zero. The Church numeral two becomes lambda lambda, one applied to one applied to zero. Free variables require their own representation. <bookmark mark='b'/> Alpha-equivalent terms then have the same bound-variable structure. This removes fresh-name choices, but substitution still requires correct index shifting when crossing binders. Indices do not make capture bugs impossible. <bookmark mark='c'/> Compilers and proof assistants use these representations to make binding precise. Part 15 adds environments and closures, which can implement application without repeatedly copying and renaming whole term trees.
0b091b5a401b.zh: 德布鲁因指标去掉了约束变量的名字。<bookmark mark='a'/>零指向最近的外层绑定，一指向再外一层，依此类推。λx.x 变为 λ 零；丘奇数二变为两个 λ，里面是一作用于一作用于零。自由变量还需要独立的表示。<bookmark mark='b'/>于是 α 等价的项具有相同的约束变量结构。这消除了选择新名字的工作，但代换跨越绑定时，仍必须正确移动指标。使用指标并不能让捕获错误变得不可能。<bookmark mark='c'/>编译器和证明助手用这些表示精确处理绑定。第十五部分将加入环境和闭包，让函数应用不必反复复制、改名整棵项树。

e5b92b8d92a6.en: Add booleans and numbers to the calculus, and some programs make no sense. <bookmark mark='a'/> If zero then true else false. The successor of true. The predecessor of a boolean. True applied to zero. Is zero of a function. <bookmark mark='b'/> Each one stops somewhere that is not an answer, with no rule to apply. It is stuck. On a real machine, the same mistake is a crash, or worse, a silent wrong answer computed from bits that meant something else. <bookmark mark='c'/> Types rule such programs out before they run. Robin Milner put it in a slogan in 1978: well-typed programs cannot go wrong. The next two chapters prove it.
e5b92b8d92a6.zh: 给演算加上布尔值和数字，有些程序就毫无意义了。<bookmark mark='a'/>if 0 then true else false。true 的后继。一个布尔值的前驱。true 作用于 0。一个函数是否为零。<bookmark mark='b'/>每一个都停在一个不是答案的地方，没有规则可用。它卡住了。在真实的机器上，同样的错误就是一次崩溃，或者更糟，一个由本来另有含义的位算出来的无声的错误答案。<bookmark mark='c'/>类型在程序运行之前就排除这样的程序。罗宾·米尔纳在 1978 年把它概括成一句口号：良类型的程序不会出错。接下来两章会证明它。

a39a3e13b3cf.en: The simply typed lambda calculus adds types to the language. <bookmark mark='a'/> A type is bool, or nat, or a function type A arrow B. <bookmark mark='b'/> Terms are as before, with booleans, numbers and their operations, except that every lambda states the type of its parameter. <bookmark mark='c'/> A arrow B is the type of functions from A to B. Arrows group to the right, so nat to nat to nat is a function of two numbers. <bookmark mark='d'/> Church introduced this system in 1940, not for programming, but to keep logic consistent: the untyped calculus could express paradoxes.
a39a3e13b3cf.zh: 简单类型 λ 演算给语言加上了类型。<bookmark mark='a'/>类型是 Bool，或者 Nat，或者函数类型 A → B。<bookmark mark='b'/>项和以前一样，带有布尔值、数字和它们的运算，只是每个 λ 都要声明参数的类型。<bookmark mark='c'/>A → B 是从 A 到 B 的函数的类型。箭头向右结合，所以 Nat → Nat → Nat 是一个有两个数字参数的函数。<bookmark mark='d'/>丘奇在 1940 年引入这个系统，不是为了编程，而是为了保持逻辑的一致：无类型的演算能表达悖论。

e2ca8f4625b3.en: The type checker applies a handful of rules, written as in Part 13: what must be known above the line, what follows below. <bookmark mark='a'/> A variable has the type the context gives it. <bookmark mark='b'/> To type a function, assume its parameter has the declared type, and type the body; the function's type is the arrow from one to the other. <bookmark mark='c'/> A function from A to B, applied to an A, gives a B, and only an A will do. <bookmark mark='d'/> The successor of a number is a number, and an if needs a boolean condition and two branches of the same type. That is the whole checker.
e2ca8f4625b3.zh: 类型检查器应用寥寥几条规则，写法和第13部分一样：横线上方是必须已知的，下方是由此推出的。<bookmark mark='a'/>变量的类型由上下文给出。<bookmark mark='b'/>要给函数定型，就假定参数具有声明的类型，再给函数体定型；函数的类型是从前者到后者的箭头。<bookmark mark='c'/>从 A 到 B 的函数作用于一个 A，得到一个 B，而且只接受 A。<bookmark mark='d'/>数的后继是数；if 需要一个布尔条件和两个同类型的分支。整个检查器就这些。

66944bd178bb.en: Typing a whole term builds a tree of rules, called a derivation. <bookmark mark='a'/> Here our checker types lambda x of type nat, successor of x, applied to two. At the bottom is the conclusion: the term has type nat, by the application rule. Above it, its two premises: the function has type nat to nat, by the abstraction rule, which in turn rests on typing successor of x with x assumed to be a nat. And the argument two is a nat, as the successor of the successor of zero. <bookmark mark='b'/> Every well-typed term has such a tree, and the checker's work is exactly to build it. For a term that applies twice to successor and three, the tree has sixteen rules.
66944bd178bb.zh: 给整个项定型会建起一棵规则树，叫作推导。<bookmark mark='a'/>这里我们的检查器给 λx:Nat. succ x 作用于 2 定型。底部是结论：这个项的类型是 Nat，由应用规则得出。它上面是两个前提：函数的类型是 Nat → Nat，由抽象规则得出，而这又建立在假定 x 是 Nat 时给 succ x 定型的基础上。实参 2 是 Nat，因为它是零的后继的后继。<bookmark mark='b'/>每个良类型的项都有这样一棵树，检查器的工作正是把它建出来。对把 twice 作用于 succ 和 3 的项，这棵树有十六条规则。

4ae84b3f6b29.en: Typed terms run the same way as before, one small step at a time, by call-by-value. <bookmark mark='a'/> Twice, applied to successor and three. First the function position is reduced, substituting successor for f. Then the argument three goes in. The inner application must finish before the outer one can fire, and the answer is five. <bookmark mark='b'/> Each step is justified by a rule, named on the left, and the next chapter proves something about every such step.
4ae84b3f6b29.zh: 有类型的项和以前一样运行，按传值调用一小步一小步地走。<bookmark mark='a'/>twice 作用于 succ 和 3。先归约函数位置，把 succ 代入 f。然后实参 3 进去。内层的应用必须先完成，外层的才能触发，答案是五。<bookmark mark='b'/>每一步都由一条规则支持，名字写在左边，而下一章要证明关于每一个这样的步骤的一件事。

795185070eec.en: Chapter eight. Well-typed programs cannot go wrong.
795185070eec.zh: 第八章。良类型的程序不会出错。

330768239bdb.en: Milner's slogan is a theorem with two halves. <bookmark mark='a'/> Progress: a closed well-typed term is either a value, a finished answer, or it can take a step. It is never stuck. <bookmark mark='b'/> Preservation: if a well-typed term takes a step, the result has the same type. <bookmark mark='c'/> Put them together along any run of the program. Each term has type T, by preservation, so each one is either an answer or can step again, by progress. A well-typed program never reaches a stuck state.
330768239bdb.zh: 米尔纳的口号是一条分成两半的定理。<bookmark mark='a'/>进展性：一个封闭的良类型项，要么是一个值，也就是完成了的答案，要么能走一步。它永远不会卡住。<bookmark mark='b'/>保持性：如果一个良类型的项走了一步，结果具有相同的类型。<bookmark mark='c'/>把两者沿程序的任意一次运行结合起来。由保持性，每个项都具有类型 T，所以由进展性，每个项要么是答案，要么能再走一步。良类型的程序永远不会到达卡住的状态。

69b21bbe5457.en: The proofs go by induction on the typing derivation, one case per rule. Here is the interesting case of progress. <bookmark mark='a'/> The term is an application, f of a, where f has type A to B and a has type A. <bookmark mark='b'/> By induction, f is a value or can step. If it can step, so can f of a. <bookmark mark='c'/> If f is a value, then because its type is an arrow, it must be a lambda: the only values of function type are functions. This little lemma, canonical forms, is where the types do their work. <bookmark mark='d'/> Then the argument is a value or can step, and if it is a value, the whole term is a redex. <bookmark mark='e'/> For an if, the condition is either a step away or a value of type bool, which can only be true or false. In every case, the types say which values can appear in which positions, and no stuck combination survives.
69b21bbe5457.zh: 证明按类型推导做归纳，每条规则一种情形。这是进展性里有意思的那个情形。<bookmark mark='a'/>项是一个应用 f a，其中 f 的类型是 A → B，a 的类型是 A。<bookmark mark='b'/>由归纳，f 是值或者能走一步。如果能走一步，f a 也能。<bookmark mark='c'/>如果 f 是值，那么因为它的类型是箭头，它必定是一个 λ：函数类型的值只有函数。这个小引理叫典范形式，类型正是在这里发挥作用。<bookmark mark='d'/>然后实参是值或者能走一步；如果是值，整个项就是一个可约式。<bookmark mark='e'/>对 if，条件要么还差一步，要么是 Bool 类型的值，只能是 true 或 false。在每种情形下，类型都规定了哪些值能出现在哪些位置，于是卡住的组合一个也留不下来。

cd446a0247f9.en: Preservation rests on one lemma. <bookmark mark='a'/> The only step that changes a term's shape much is beta reduction, which substitutes an argument for a parameter. <bookmark mark='b'/> When we typed the redex, we typed the body t assuming x is an A, and we typed the argument s as an A. <bookmark mark='c'/> The substitution lemma says that putting a real A where an A was assumed leaves the body's type unchanged. It is proved, in turn, by induction on the derivation of t. With it, preservation follows case by case.
cd446a0247f9.zh: 保持性依赖于一个引理。<bookmark mark='a'/>唯一会大幅改变项的形状的一步是 β 归约，它用实参代换参数。<bookmark mark='b'/>给这个可约式定型时，我们在假定 x 是 A 的情况下给函数体 t 定了型，又把实参 s 定型为 A。<bookmark mark='c'/>代换引理说：把一个真正的 A 放在假定为 A 的地方，函数体的类型保持不变。它本身也通过对 t 的推导做归纳来证明。有了它，保持性就逐个情形地成立了。

66e33f1a668b.en: Finite checks exercise the implementation of the safety rules. <bookmark mark='a'/> The generator constructs five thousand closed, well-typed terms from its stated grammar and seed. <bookmark mark='b'/> In the recorded run, all finish after fifty thousand five hundred and sixteen small steps in total, with typing checked after every step. <bookmark mark='c'/> No sampled state is stuck and no step changes its type. A failed case would expose a bug in the generator, checker or evaluator; passing this sample is not a proof of the general theorems. <bookmark mark='d'/> The longest sampled run takes forty-seven steps. That bound belongs only to these generated terms. The next chapter's normalization theorem explains why every term in the recursion-free typed calculus terminates, without giving this particular sample bound to all programs.
66e33f1a668b.zh: 有限检查用来检验安全规则的实现。<bookmark mark='a'/>生成器按照规定的语法和随机种子，构造五千个封闭、良类型的项。<bookmark mark='b'/>记录中的运行全部结束，总共五万零五百一十六个小步，每步之后都重新检查类型。<bookmark mark='c'/>样本中没有卡住的状态，也没有类型变化。反例会暴露生成器、检查器或求值器中的错误；样本全通过，不等于证明一般定理。<bookmark mark='d'/>样本中最长运行四十七步。这个上界只属于这些生成项。下一章的正规化定理解释没有一般递归的类型演算为何每个项都终止，并不会把这个样本上界推广到所有程序。

a241c73177bb.en: Safety results belong to a language and its operational model. <bookmark mark='a'/> Standard ML has a formal definition and machine-checked metatheoretic work; the precise theorem depends on the modeled features. <bookmark mark='b'/> Managed Java and C sharp designs enforce important safety properties, and the JVM verifies bytecode. Native interfaces, unsafe facilities and implementation defects lie outside a simple blanket claim. <bookmark mark='c'/> RustBelt's 2018 work proves soundness for a realistic Rust subset and verifies selected unsafe library abstractions against explicit contracts. It is not a proof of every Rust feature, library or compiler version. Safe clients rely on those contracts being upheld. <bookmark mark='d'/> C and C plus plus permit well-typed programs with out-of-bounds accesses and other undefined behavior. Their static types do not establish this lesson's safety guarantee. <bookmark mark='e'/> In our calculus, cannot go wrong means no reachable stuck term. It does not establish termination, intended answers or the absence of every operational failure in a production system.
a241c73177bb.zh: 安全性结果属于某个语言及其操作模型。<bookmark mark='a'/>Standard ML 有形式化定义，也有机器检查的元理论工作；精确定理取决于模型涵盖的特性。<bookmark mark='b'/>受管 Java 和 C sharp 的设计实施了重要安全性质，JVM 还会验证字节码。原生接口、不安全设施和实现缺陷，不能用一句笼统承诺涵盖。<bookmark mark='c'/>RustBelt 在二零一八年的工作，为一个较现实的 Rust 子集证明可靠性，并按明确契约验证选定的不安全库抽象。它不等于证明所有 Rust 特性、库和编译器版本。安全客户端依赖这些契约确实得到遵守。<bookmark mark='d'/>C 和 C++ 允许类型正确却越界访问的程序，以及其他未定义行为；它们的静态类型不建立本课的安全保证。<bookmark mark='e'/>在本演算中，不会出错表示不会到达卡住的项，不表示必定终止、答案符合意图，或生产系统没有任何运行故障。

08a0dcca967e.en: Chapter nine. Why the typed core terminates.
08a0dcca967e.zh: 第九章。类型核心为何终止。

4ef6da1bda30.en: Try typing lambda x, x x with finite simple types. <bookmark mark='a'/> In its function position, x must have some arrow type A to B. <bookmark mark='b'/> The same x is also its own argument, which must have type A. Simple typing gives that binder one monomorphic type. <bookmark mark='c'/> Unification therefore demands A equals A to B, with A occurring inside its own proposed definition. <bookmark mark='d'/> No finite simple type solves this equation. Recursive-type systems or richer polymorphic rules are different systems and require their own reasoning. <bookmark mark='e'/> Our Hindley Milner engine rejects this application with its occurs check. Omega and Y are untypable in the recursion-free simply typed calculus. Their rejection is a fact about this typing discipline; it is not a claim that every language with static types rejects all self-application or recursion.
4ef6da1bda30.zh: 试着用有限简单类型，给 λx.xx 定型。<bookmark mark='a'/>在函数位置，x 必须具有某个箭头类型 A 到 B。<bookmark mark='b'/>同一个 x 又是实参，因此必须具有 A 类型。简单定型给这个绑定一个单态类型。<bookmark mark='c'/>合一于是要求 A 等于 A 到 B，A 出现在为它提出的定义内部。<bookmark mark='d'/>没有有限简单类型能解这个方程。递归类型系统或更丰富的多态规则，是不同系统，需要另行推理。<bookmark mark='e'/>我们的欣德利–米尔纳引擎用出现检查拒绝这个应用。Ω 和 Y 在无一般递归的简单类型演算中不可定型。这属于这套定型规则的结论，不表示所有静态类型语言都拒绝一切自身应用或递归。

71185bf8e7b1.en: In fact no typed term runs forever. <bookmark mark='a'/> William Tait proved in 1967 that every well-typed term of the simply typed calculus reaches a normal form, whichever order of reduction you choose. <bookmark mark='b'/> The obvious proof by induction on the size of the term fails, because a beta step can make a term bigger, by copying its argument. <bookmark mark='c'/> Tait's idea was to prove something stronger, defined by induction on the type. A number is good if it terminates. A function is good if it sends every good argument to a good result. <bookmark mark='d'/> Then show that every typed term is good, and every good term terminates. This method, now called logical relations, has been the workhorse of type theory ever since.
71185bf8e7b1.zh: 事实上，没有一个有类型的项会永远运行。<bookmark mark='a'/>威廉·泰特在 1967 年证明：简单类型演算里每个良类型的项都能到达范式，无论选择哪种归约顺序。<bookmark mark='b'/>按项的大小做归纳这种显而易见的证明行不通，因为一步 β 归约可能通过复制实参让项变大。<bookmark mark='c'/>泰特的想法是证明一个更强的性质，按类型归纳地定义。一个数是好的，如果它会终止。一个函数是好的，如果它把每个好的实参都送到好的结果。<bookmark mark='d'/>然后证明每个有类型的项都是好的，而每个好的项都会终止。这种方法如今叫作逻辑关系，从此一直是类型论的主力工具。

70db2640dd75.en: The experiment compares two generated populations. <bookmark mark='a'/> Of two thousand random closed untyped terms, one hundred and thirty-six do not finish within four hundred normal-order steps. That means the budget was exhausted; it does not independently prove that each of those terms diverges. The sampling grammar and seed define this population. <bookmark mark='b'/> All five thousand terms in the separate well-typed sample finish within the evaluator's limits. No finite experiment establishes universal termination. For the recursion-free simply typed calculus, strong normalization supplies the general theorem. The bar chart reports the samples; the proof explains the model's guarantee.
70db2640dd75.zh: 实验比较的是两组生成样本。<bookmark mark='a'/>两千个随机封闭无类型项中，一百三十六个在四百个正规序步骤内没有结束。这表示预算用尽，不能单独证明其中每一个都发散。采样语法和种子规定了这组总体。<bookmark mark='b'/>另一组五千个良类型项，全部在求值器限制内结束。任何有限实验都不能建立普遍终止性；对没有一般递归的简单类型演算，强正规化才提供一般定理。柱状图报告样本，证明解释模型的保证。

b99dd5afc0b8.en: Strong normalization has a precise boundary. <bookmark mark='a'/> The simply typed calculus without general recursion cannot express a divergent computation, so it is not Turing complete. Diagonal arguments also restrict universal evaluation with a common type of program codes. Encoding assumptions matter: differently typed notions of self-interpretation need separate treatment. <bookmark mark='b'/> A general fixed-point operator changes the calculus. Given a function from T to T, fix produces a T, and its unfolding can continue forever. Safety can survive this extension even though termination does not. <bookmark mark='c'/> ML, Haskell and OCaml support general recursion. Proof assistants keep their trusted logical core consistent by restricting recursive definitions or requiring termination arguments. Their executable facilities can also include partial, unsafe or noncomputable features with carefully separated trust rules. The theorem concerns the specified core, not every command a proof-assistant installation can execute.
b99dd5afc0b8.zh: 强正规化有精确的适用边界。<bookmark mark='a'/>不带一般递归的简单类型演算不能表达发散计算，因此不是图灵完备的。对角论证也限制了使用统一程序编码类型的通用求值器。编码假设很重要：使用不同类型编码的自解释概念，需要另行讨论。<bookmark mark='b'/>加入一般不动点算子，就改变了演算。给定 T 到 T 的函数，fix 产生一个 T，它的展开可能永远继续。这个扩展可以保留安全性，却不再保证终止。<bookmark mark='c'/>ML、Haskell 和 OCaml 支持一般递归。证明助手为了维持可信逻辑核心的一致性，会限制递归定义，或要求终止论证。它们的可执行设施也可能包含部分函数、不安全或不可计算功能，并使用独立的信任规则。定理针对明确规定的核心，不是证明助手安装环境能够执行的每一条命令。

abff8f008dff.zh: 第十章。欣德利–米尔纳推断。

983413e25e89.en: In the hook, nobody wrote a type, yet the machine knew them all. Here is how. <bookmark mark='a'/> Take the function that applies f twice. <bookmark mark='b'/> Give each unknown a type variable: f has some type alpha, x some type beta. <bookmark mark='c'/> Every use adds an equation. f applied to x says alpha must be a function from beta to some gamma. <bookmark mark='d'/> And f applied to f of x says alpha is also a function from gamma to some delta. <bookmark mark='e'/> Inference is solving these equations between types, which is called unification.
983413e25e89.zh: 在开场，没有人写类型，机器却全都知道。原理是这样的。<bookmark mark='a'/>拿把 f 作用两次的函数来说。<bookmark mark='b'/>给每个未知量一个类型变量：f 是某个类型 α，x 是某个类型 β。<bookmark mark='c'/>每次使用都增加一个方程。f 作用于 x 说明 α 必须是从 β 到某个 γ 的函数。<bookmark mark='d'/>f 作用于 f x 说明 α 也是从 γ 到某个 δ 的函数。<bookmark mark='e'/>推断就是求解这些类型之间的方程，这叫作合一。

310db16b51a1.en: Alan Robinson gave the algorithm in 1965, for automated theorem proving. <bookmark mark='a'/> An equation between a variable and a type binds the variable to that type, everywhere it appears. <bookmark mark='b'/> An equation between two function types splits into two equations: arguments equal, results equal. <bookmark mark='c'/> Two different type constructors, like int and bool, cannot be equal: that is a type error. <bookmark mark='d'/> And a variable cannot be bound to a type that contains it: that would be the infinite type of omega. <bookmark mark='e'/> When unification succeeds, it finds the most general solution, of which every other solution is a special case.
310db16b51a1.zh: 艾伦·鲁宾逊在 1965 年为自动定理证明给出了这个算法。<bookmark mark='a'/>变量与类型之间的方程，把这个变量绑定到那个类型，在它出现的每一处。<bookmark mark='b'/>两个函数类型之间的方程拆成两个方程：参数相等，结果相等。<bookmark mark='c'/>两个不同的类型构造子，比如 int 和 bool，不能相等：这是一个类型错误。<bookmark mark='d'/>一个变量不能绑定到包含它自己的类型：那就是 Ω 的无限类型。<bookmark mark='e'/>合一成功时，它找到的是最一般的解，其他每个解都是它的特例。

8b574c270bfe.en: Here is our engine's own trace for twice. <bookmark mark='a'/> It assumes fresh variables for f and x. From f of x it binds f's variable to a function from x's variable to a new one. From the outer application it must unify that function type with another, which splits into two bindings. <bookmark mark='b'/> What is left is the principal type: for any type tick a, a function from tick a to tick a, then a tick a, gives a tick a. <bookmark mark='c'/> Composition comes out just as neatly, with three independent type variables. This is algorithm W, from Milner's 1978 paper; Roger Hindley had found the principal types of combinatory logic in 1969.
8b574c270bfe.zh: 这是我们的引擎对 twice 的推断轨迹。<bookmark mark='a'/>它为 f 和 x 假定新的变量。从 f x，它把 f 的变量绑定到一个从 x 的变量到一个新变量的函数。从外层的应用，它必须把这个函数类型与另一个合一，拆成两次绑定。<bookmark mark='b'/>剩下的就是主类型：对任何类型 'a，一个从 'a 到 'a 的函数，再加一个 'a，得到一个 'a。<bookmark mark='c'/>组合同样干净利落，有三个独立的类型变量。这就是米尔纳 1978 年论文里的算法 W；罗杰·欣德利在 1969 年已经找到了组合逻辑的主类型。

e17df3693d7c.en: Let-polymorphism adds a controlled form of reuse. <bookmark mark='a'/> Bind the identity with let and use it at int and bool: the pair has type int times bool. A lambda parameter, used at both types in ordinary Hindley Milner, is instead rejected. <bookmark mark='b'/> Generalization quantifies the inferred type variables that are not free in the surrounding type environment. Variables tied to an outer parameter must stay shared. Each use then instantiates the quantified variables freshly. <bookmark mark='c'/> A lambda-bound parameter is monomorphic within its scope. This distinction is enough for principal types and decidable inference in the pure Hindley Milner system; mutation requires further restrictions such as ML's value restriction. <bookmark mark='d'/> Full implicit System F typability is undecidable. More expressive annotated or restricted systems can still have decidable checking or inference, so there is no single boundary saying that all richer polymorphism is impossible.
e17df3693d7c.zh: let 多态让复用受到控制。<bookmark mark='a'/>用 let 绑定恒等函数，再分别作用于整数和布尔值，序对类型是 int 乘 bool。普通欣德利–米尔纳系统则拒绝把同一个 λ 参数用于这两种类型。<bookmark mark='b'/>泛化只量化推断类型中不自由出现在外部类型环境里的变量。与外层参数相连的变量必须继续共享。每次使用，再为被量化的变量建立新实例。<bookmark mark='c'/>λ 绑定的参数在其作用域内保持单态。这个区别让纯欣德利–米尔纳系统具有主类型和可判定推断；可变状态还需要 ML 值限制一类的条件。<bookmark mark='d'/>完全隐式的 System F 可定型性不可判定。不过，更有表达力但带标注或受限制的系统，仍可能支持可判定检查或推断，不能把它说成所有更丰富多态都不可能的统一边界。

5855285472ed.en: Here is the whole Job, as the hook promised. <bookmark mark='a'/> Eleven definitions, a few hundred unifications, and not one annotation. Reverse works on lists of anything. Lower and is letter work on character codes. Bump and count work for any type of word that supports equality, and insert and sort for any pair whose second part is a count. <bookmark mark='b'/> The type variables are a precise statement of what each function does not care about, discovered rather than declared.
5855285472ed.zh: 这是完整的任务，正如开场所承诺的。<bookmark mark='a'/>十一个定义，几百次合一，没有一个标注。反转适用于任何东西的列表。lower 和 is_letter 作用于字符编码。bump 和 count 适用于任何支持相等比较的单词类型，insert 和 sort 适用于任何第二部分是计数的序对。<bookmark mark='b'/>这些类型变量精确地说明了每个函数不关心什么，而且是被发现的，不是被声明的。

e52ca71fc121.en: Small source programs can describe enormous expanded types. <bookmark mark='a'/> In this family, f zero pairs its argument with itself. Each following function applies its predecessor twice. <bookmark mark='b'/> The number of leaves in the fully expanded result type squares at each level: two to the power two to the n. Count leaves, rather than source characters or stored graph nodes. <bookmark mark='c'/> Sharing keeps repeated subtypes in a graph. Our recorded inference handles the displayed f five without expanding its more than four billion result leaves; host timing is a separate measurement and can vary. This family illustrates representation blowup, not a proof that every implementation spends that much time. <bookmark mark='d'/> Deciding typability in the relevant unrestricted ML let-polymorphism problem is EXPTIME-complete, as the 1990 results show. That decision bound differs from printing a fully expanded principal type. Practical performance depends on the program family, shared representation and implementation.
e52ca71fc121.zh: 很小的源程序也能描述巨大的展开类型。<bookmark mark='a'/>本例中，f 零把实参与自身组成序对；后面的每个函数都连续应用前一个函数两次。<bookmark mark='b'/>完全展开的结果类型，其叶子数每层平方，达到二的二的 n 次方次方。这里数的是叶子，不是源字符，也不是存储图的结点。<bookmark mark='c'/>共享表示把重复子类型保存在图里。记录中的推断处理了屏幕上的 f 五，无需展开超过四十亿个结果叶子；主机耗时是另一项会变化的测量。这个函数族说明表示膨胀，不证明每个实现都要花同样多的时间。<bookmark mark='d'/>一九九零年的结果表明，相应的不受限 ML let 多态可定型性判定问题是指数时间完备的。这与打印完全展开的主类型不同。实际性能取决于程序族、共享表示和实现。

117c38991c47.en: Chapter eleven. Polymorphism and free theorems.
117c38991c47.zh: 第十一章。多态与免费定理。

98641e3d666e.en: System F makes polymorphism explicit and allows quantifiers inside function types. <bookmark mark='a'/> Types gain for all alpha. Terms gain type abstraction, capital lambda alpha, and explicit type application. Girard introduced the system in 1972 and Reynolds independently in 1974. <bookmark mark='b'/> The identity first receives a type and then a value of that type. <bookmark mark='c'/> A function can now receive a polymorphic identity and instantiate it at both int and bool. The displayed pair uses the corresponding product extension. Ordinary Hindley Milner does not allow this higher-rank parameter without an extension. <bookmark mark='d'/> Distinguish two tasks. Checking fully annotated Church-style System F is decidable. Finding omitted type abstractions and applications in the unrestricted Curry-style typability problem is undecidable. Annotations or restricted inference systems make useful intermediate choices.
98641e3d666e.zh: System F 把多态明确写出，并允许量词出现在函数类型内部。<bookmark mark='a'/>类型增加全称量词，项增加大 λ 表示的类型抽象，以及显式类型应用。吉拉尔在一九七二年提出这个系统，雷诺兹在一九七四年独立提出。<bookmark mark='b'/>恒等函数先接受一个类型，再接受该类型的值。<bookmark mark='c'/>函数现在可以接受一个多态恒等函数，并分别在 int 和 bool 上实例化它。屏幕中的序对使用相应的积类型扩展。普通欣德利–米尔纳系统没有扩展时，不允许这样的高阶参数。<bookmark mark='d'/>要区分两个任务。完全标注的丘奇风格 System F，其类型检查可判定；在不受限的柯里风格可定型性问题中，补出省略的类型抽象和应用，则不可判定。类型标注或受限推断系统提供了有用的中间选择。

9c5479b19a23.en: Church encodings receive explicit polymorphic types here. <bookmark mark='a'/> A boolean chooses between two arguments of one arbitrary type. A numeral iterates a function, and a list provides a fold over its element type. The quantifiers let callers choose the result type. <bookmark mark='b'/> For closed terms in the pure total system, normalization and parametricity give these encodings their expected behavior. System F is strongly normalizing, yet represents a large class of total numerical functions related to second-order arithmetic's provably total functions. That is a precise proof-theoretic connection, not a claim that every mathematical function is computable or expressible. General recursion, effects and additional primitives require a fresh analysis of these properties.
9c5479b19a23.zh: 丘奇编码在这里获得显式多态类型。<bookmark mark='a'/>布尔值在任意同一类型的两个实参中选择；数反复应用函数；列表提供对元素类型的折叠。量词让调用者选择结果类型。<bookmark mark='b'/>对纯粹且全终止系统中的封闭项，正规化与参数性让这些编码具有预期行为。System F 强正规化，同时能表示与二阶算术可证全函数相关的丰富数值函数族。这是精确的证明论联系，不表示每个数学函数都可计算或可表达。加入一般递归、副作用或额外原语后，需要重新分析这些性质。

56c46519066e.en: A type can imply an equation when the language supplies parametricity. Work first in a pure, total setting. <bookmark mark='a'/> A closed function of type for all alpha, alpha to alpha must return its argument: it has no other alpha to manufacture. <bookmark mark='b'/> At for all alpha, alpha to alpha to alpha, it must consistently choose one of its two arguments, giving a Church boolean. <bookmark mark='c'/> For a function from lists of alpha to lists of alpha, behavior can depend on list shape while elements can only be rearranged, dropped or copied. It cannot inspect an arbitrary alpha. <bookmark mark='d'/> The square commutes: map f after g equals g after map f, for total f and finite lists in this model. Reynolds's parametricity supports the proof; Wadler popularized such free theorems. With divergence, effects, runtime type inspection or primitives such as Haskell's seq, the assumptions and resulting theorem need adjustment.
56c46519066e.zh: 当语言满足参数性时，类型能推出方程。先在纯粹、全终止的环境中讨论。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个封闭函数，类型为对所有 α，α 到 α，只能返回实参，因为它不能凭空制造另一个 α。<bookmark mark='b'/>类型为对所有 α，α 到 α 到 α 时，它必须一致地选择两个实参中的一个，因此得到丘奇布尔值。<bookmark mark='c'/>从 α 列表到 α 列表的函数，可以根据列表形状决定行为，但对元素只能重排、丢弃或复制，不能检查任意 α 的内部。<bookmark mark='d'/>这个方块可交换：先做 g 再 map f，等于先 map f 再 g；这里 f 是全函数，列表有限。雷诺兹的参数性支持证明，瓦德勒推广了免费定理的说法。若加入发散、副作用、运行时类型检查，或 Haskell 的 seq 一类原语，就必须调整假设及结论。

b60a9f63d088.en: The lambda-core experiment needs one more boundary. <bookmark mark='a'/> Four shape-based functions reverse, take three, select every other element and duplicate elements. Each passes two hundred sampled comparisons using finite lists and integer affine maps. <bookmark mark='b'/> These results exercise those implementations; they do not prove a universal equation for every function with that printed type. <bookmark mark='c'/> The monomorphic add-one witness fails. More subtly, our toy core has unrestricted polymorphic equality. A function that compares its first two elements still receives the printed type tick a list to tick a list, yet a constant map can merge unequal elements and break the equation. That primitive is outside pure System F parametricity. Real ML equality constraints also need more modeling than this toy type printer supplies. <bookmark mark='d'/> Follow both routes through the diagram, and check the counterexample. Compiler fusion needs a valid equation under the actual language semantics and rule conditions; type compatibility alone is insufficient.
b60a9f63d088.zh: λ 核心实验还需要一个边界。<bookmark mark='a'/>四个只看形状的函数，分别反转、取前三个、隔一个取一个，以及复制元素。每个都通过了两百次有限列表和整数仿射映射的采样比较。<bookmark mark='b'/>结果检验的是这些实现，不是证明具有同样类型写法的每个函数都满足普遍方程。<bookmark mark='c'/>单态的逐元素加一反例失败。更微妙的是，我们的小型核心有不受限的多态相等操作。比较前两个元素的函数，仍会显示为 'a 列表到 'a 列表；可是常值映射能把原本不等的元素合并，从而破坏方程。这个原语不满足纯 System F 参数性的条件。真实 ML 的相等类型约束，也需要比本玩具类型打印器更完整的建模。<bookmark mark='d'/>沿图的两条路线走一遍，再检查反例。编译器融合需要在实际语言语义和规则条件下成立的方程；仅有类型相容还不够。

f5b0d6484907.en: Here is the deepest idea in this part. <bookmark mark='a'/> Read a type as a proposition. A function type, A to B, is the proposition A implies B, and a function of that type is a proof of it: give it evidence for A and it produces evidence for B. <bookmark mark='b'/> A pair is a proof of A and B. A tagged union, an A or a B together with which one, is a proof of A or B. The empty type, with no values at all, is falsehood, and not A is a function from A to the empty type, which could never actually be called. <bookmark mark='c'/> A proof is a program. And simplifying a proof, removing a detour through a lemma, is exactly running the program by beta reduction. Haskell Curry noticed the first signs of this in 1934; William Howard wrote it down in full in 1969.
f5b0d6484907.zh: 这是这一部分最深刻的思想。<bookmark mark='a'/>把类型读作命题。函数类型 A → B 就是命题“A 蕴含 B”，而这个类型的函数就是它的证明：给它 A 的证据，它就产生 B 的证据。<bookmark mark='b'/>序对是“A 且 B”的证明。带标签的并，一个 A 或一个 B，并注明是哪一个，是“A 或 B”的证明。没有任何值的空类型是假，而“非 A”是从 A 到空类型的函数，它永远不可能真正被调用。<bookmark mark='c'/>证明就是程序。而简化一个证明，去掉经由某个引理的绕路，恰好就是用 β 归约运行这个程序。哈斯凯尔·柯里在 1934 年注意到了最初的迹象；威廉·霍华德在 1969 年把它完整地写了下来。

1a37817b09ea.en: If proofs are programs, a theorem prover is a program synthesizer. <bookmark mark='a'/> Our prover searches for a lambda term of a given type. A implies B implies A is the function that takes x and y and returns x: the constant combinator. Composition proves the syllogism: from A implies B and B implies C, A implies C. Swapping a pair proves that and is commutative. Case analysis on a tagged union proves that or can be eliminated. <bookmark mark='b'/> And the last row is a small gem: not not of A or not A. It sounds like excluded middle, but it is provable without it. The program is a trick: it is handed a refutation x, and uses it against itself.
1a37817b09ea.zh: 如果证明就是程序，定理证明器就是程序合成器。<bookmark mark='a'/>我们的证明器搜索给定类型的 λ 项。“A 蕴含 B 蕴含 A”是接受 x 和 y、返回 x 的函数：常函数组合子。组合证明了三段论：由 A 蕴含 B 和 B 蕴含 C，得 A 蕴含 C。交换序对证明了“且”可交换。对带标签的并做情形分析证明了“或”可以消去。<bookmark mark='b'/>最后一行是一颗小宝石：非非（A 或非 A）。它听起来像排中律，却无需排中律就能证明。程序是一个巧招：它拿到一个反驳 x，然后用它来反驳它自己。

31d45dd7d9ec.en: Classical truth and constructive inhabitation differ in the stated logical core. <bookmark mark='a'/> Excluded middle, double-negation elimination, Peirce's law and the displayed half of de Morgan's law all pass classical truth tables. Here A and B are arbitrary proposition variables. <bookmark mark='b'/> Our proof search finds no pure intuitionistic proof terms for them. A failed finite search alone would not prove nonexistence. The next panel supplies Kripke countermodels, and soundness of the logical rules turns those models into a non-inhabitation argument for this calculus. General recursion, control operators or additional axioms change that calculus. <bookmark mark='c'/> A constructive proof of A or not A must provide either evidence for A or a refutation, together with the selected alternative. There is no uniform term supplying that choice for every arbitrary A under these rules. Particular propositions can still have decidable proofs or refutations; this claim does not deny ordinary decision algorithms.
31d45dd7d9ec.zh: 在明确规定的逻辑核心中，经典真值与构造性居民不同。<bookmark mark='a'/>排中律、双重否定消去、皮尔斯律，以及屏幕中的半条德摩根律，都通过经典真值表；这里 A、B 是任意命题变量。<bookmark mark='b'/>证明搜索没有找到它们的纯直觉主义证明项。有限搜索失败，本身不能证明不存在；下一幅图提供克里普克反模型，逻辑规则的可靠性再把反模型转化为本演算中的无居民论证。加入一般递归、控制算子或额外公理，会改变演算。<bookmark mark='c'/>A 或非 A 的构造性证明，必须提供 A 的证据或反驳，并指出选了哪个分支。在这些规则下，没有对每个任意 A 都提供这种选择的统一项。具体命题仍可能有可判定的证明或反驳；这不否认普通的判定算法。

a1ca24bff747.en: To show that no program exists, we need a world where the formula fails and programs still make sense. Saul Kripke supplied one in 1965. <bookmark mark='a'/> Picture states of knowledge, which only grow, upward. In the lower world, w zero, we do not yet know A. In the world above it, we do. <bookmark mark='b'/> At w zero, A is not known. Not A is not known either, because not A would mean A can never become known, and above us it does. So A or not A fails at w zero. <bookmark mark='c'/> And every formula that has a program holds in every such model. So excluded middle has no program. Our search finds a two-world model like this for each of the first three laws, and a three-world model for de Morgan's.
a1ca24bff747.zh: 要证明不存在程序，我们需要一个世界，在其中公式不成立，而程序仍然有意义。索尔·克里普克在 1965 年提供了一个。<bookmark mark='a'/>想象知识的状态，它只会向上增长。在下面的世界 w0 中，我们还不知道 A。在它上面的世界里，我们知道了。<bookmark mark='b'/>在 w0，A 不被知道。非 A 也不被知道，因为非 A 意味着 A 永远不会被知道，而在上面它被知道了。所以 A 或非 A 在 w0 不成立。<bookmark mark='c'/>而每个有程序的公式在每个这样的模型中都成立。所以排中律没有程序。我们的搜索为前三条定律各找到一个这样的两世界模型，为德摩根律找到一个三世界模型。

4e36d2ff3027.en: Control operators change the logical calculus. <bookmark mark='a'/> Griffin's 1990 work connects a typed control operator with classical reasoning. The displayed Peirce type is uninhabited in the pure intuitionistic calculus, but a suitable call-with-current-continuation operator provides it in an extended control calculus. <bookmark mark='b'/> Operationally, call cc captures the current continuation: what the program would do next. Invoking that captured continuation supplies a result and transfers control to that saved context. It does not reverse time, roll back arbitrary effects or erase earlier output. The typing and evaluation rules determine the corresponding classical interpretation. <bookmark mark='c'/> Part 15 builds continuations and shows their execution directly. <bookmark mark='d'/> Proof assistants also use propositions as types, with a specified trusted kernel, rules and axioms. Checking a proof term establishes a proposition relative to those assumptions; the presence of a control operator in a programming language does not automatically extend a proof assistant's logic.
4e36d2ff3027.zh: 控制算子会改变逻辑演算。<bookmark mark='a'/>格里芬一九九零年的工作，把带类型控制算子与经典推理联系起来。屏幕中的皮尔斯类型，在纯直觉主义演算中没有居民；合适的 call-with-current-continuation 算子，则能在扩展的控制演算中提供它。<bookmark mark='b'/>操作上，call cc 捕获当前续延，也就是程序接下来会做的事。调用捕获的续延，会提供一个结果，并把控制转移到保存的上下文。它不会倒转时间、撤销任意副作用，或抹掉此前的输出。对应的经典解释取决于类型与求值规则。<bookmark mark='c'/>第十五部分会搭建续延，直接展示它的执行。<bookmark mark='d'/>证明助手也采用命题即类型，但具有明确的可信内核、规则与公理。检查证明项，是相对于这些假设建立命题；编程语言里存在控制算子，不会自动扩展证明助手的逻辑。

a2645be602f7.en: Chapter thirteen. Dependent and linear types.
a2645be602f7.zh: 第十三章。依赖类型与线性类型。

2ed223e94cfb.en: So far, types and values have lived apart. Dependent types let a type mention a value. <bookmark mark='a'/> Vec A n is the type of lists of A of length exactly n: the length is part of the type. <bookmark mark='b'/> Appending a vector of length m to one of length n gives length m plus n, and the type checker verifies the arithmetic. <bookmark mark='c'/> Head accepts only vectors of length n plus one. Taking the head of an empty list is no longer a crash at run time; it is a type error. <bookmark mark='d'/> And zip demands two vectors of the same length.
2ed223e94cfb.zh: 到目前为止，类型和值是分开的。依赖类型让类型可以提到值。<bookmark mark='a'/>Vec A n 是长度恰好为 n 的 A 的列表的类型：长度是类型的一部分。<bookmark mark='b'/>把长度为 m 的向量接到长度为 n 的向量上，得到长度 m + n，类型检查器会验证这个算术。<bookmark mark='c'/>head 只接受长度为 n + 1 的向量。取空列表的头不再是运行时的崩溃；它是一个类型错误。<bookmark mark='d'/>zip 要求两个长度相同的向量。

8e8a688345ae.en: Dependent function and pair types express two forms of evidence. <bookmark mark='a'/> Pi is a function type whose result can depend on its argument, such as a function taking n and returning a vector of length n. It corresponds to universal quantification under the propositions-as-types interpretation. <bookmark mark='b'/> Sigma pairs a witness with evidence depending on that witness: a length together with a vector of that length. It corresponds to an existential statement with explicit data. <bookmark mark='c'/> Martin-Lof's type theories and the calculus of constructions helped build constructive foundations and proof assistants. Rocq, Agda and Lean provide different systems; their kernels and computational features should not be identified with one tiny calculus. <bookmark mark='d'/> When types contain programs, definitional equality may require computation. The trusted logical core needs controlled reduction and recursion to preserve its metatheory. Executable partial or unsafe facilities can exist outside that core, with explicit restrictions on their use in proofs.
8e8a688345ae.zh: 依赖函数类型和依赖序对类型，表达两种证据。<bookmark mark='a'/>Π 的结果类型可以依赖实参，例如接受 n，再返回长度为 n 的向量。在命题即类型解释下，它对应全称量词。<bookmark mark='b'/>Σ 把见证与依赖该见证的证据组成序对，例如长度及具有该长度的向量。它对应带明确数据的存在命题。<bookmark mark='c'/>马丁–洛夫类型论和构造演算，推动了构造性基础与证明助手。Rocq、Agda 和 Lean 提供不同系统，不能把它们的内核及计算设施等同于一个小演算。<bookmark mark='d'/>类型含有程序时，定义相等可能需要计算。可信逻辑核心需要控制归约和递归，以维持元理论。核心之外可以有可执行的部分函数或不安全设施，但它们用于证明时有明确限制。

899e85db8a7c.en: A different refinement counts uses. <bookmark mark='a'/> Our checker counts how many times each classic combinator uses each parameter. The identity, composition and flip use every argument exactly once: they are linear. The constant function throws its second argument away: affine, at most once. W and S duplicate one: relevant, at least once. <bookmark mark='b'/> Jean-Yves Girard's linear logic, from 1987, treats assumptions as resources that are consumed when used. <bookmark mark='c'/> In programming the resources are real: a file handle that must be closed exactly once, a lock, a block of memory that must be freed once and never used afterwards.
899e85db8a7c.zh: 另一种细化计数使用的次数。<bookmark mark='a'/>我们的检查器统计每个经典组合子使用每个参数的次数。恒等、组合和翻转把每个参数恰好用一次：它们是线性的。常函数把第二个参数丢掉：仿射的，至多一次。W 和 S 复制了其中一个：相关的，至少一次。<bookmark mark='b'/>让-伊夫·吉拉尔 1987 年的线性逻辑把假设当作资源，用一次就消耗掉。<bookmark mark='c'/>在编程中，资源是实实在在的：必须恰好关闭一次的文件句柄、一把锁、一块必须释放一次且之后不再使用的内存。

19c160c168d8.en: Rust makes ownership and borrowing concrete. <bookmark mark='a'/> The displayed String is not a Copy value. Assigning it to kept transfers ownership, so using the moved word is rejected with E zero three eight two. This is an affine discipline: a resource can be dropped as well as consumed once. Copy types follow different rules. <bookmark mark='b'/> The second example keeps a shared reference into a vector live while requesting a mutation that could reallocate its storage. The borrow checker rejects the conflict. Shared and exclusive access rules, lifetimes and library contracts work together; the slogan many readers or one writer is an introduction, not the entire aliasing model. <bookmark mark='c'/> These mechanisms support memory and data-race safety for safe code when unsafe dependencies uphold their obligations. They do not exclude memory leaks, deadlocks, logic errors or all thread races. The recorded compiler messages demonstrate these two examples on this Rust version.
19c160c168d8.zh: Rust 把所有权和借用变成具体规则。<bookmark mark='a'/>这里的 String 不是 Copy 值。赋给 kept 会转移所有权，所以再使用已经移动的 word，会得到 E0382。这是一种仿射约束：资源可以丢弃，也可以消费一次。Copy 类型遵循不同规则。<bookmark mark='b'/>第二个例子保留着指向向量内部的共享引用，同时请求可能重新分配存储的修改，借用检查器拒绝这个冲突。共享与独占访问规则、生命周期和库契约共同工作；多个读者或一个写者只是入门概括，不是完整别名模型。<bookmark mark='c'/>当不安全依赖履行义务时，这些机制支持安全代码的内存安全与数据竞争安全，但不排除内存泄漏、死锁、逻辑错误或所有线程竞态。记录的编译器消息，展示的是当前 Rust 版本上的这两个例子。

e10651ffcf90.en: Chapter fourteen. Data, subtyping and gradual types.
e10651ffcf90.zh: 第十四章。数据、子类型与渐进类型。

6906e08573ab.en: Algebraic data types describe alternatives and their fields. <bookmark mark='a'/> A shape can be a circle with a radius or a rectangle with width and height: a sum of products. <bookmark mark='b'/> The propositions-as-types dictionary interprets these constructors as choices and pairs, with the logical assumptions stated earlier. <bookmark mark='c'/> Pattern matching inspects the constructor. Exhaustiveness checking can report missing cases, but language settings, wildcards and guards affect the guarantee. Adding a triangle does not force every match to change if a wildcard already handles it. Nested patterns need more analysis than counting constructor names. <bookmark mark='d'/> An option type makes absence an explicit alternative. It can rule out an unhandled null dereference when programs respect its interface; extracting a value can still require handling the empty case. <bookmark mark='e'/> Make illegal states unrepresentable is a useful design goal. A type can encode a chosen invariant, not automatically every property the application needs.
6906e08573ab.zh: 代数数据类型描述不同选择及其字段。<bookmark mark='a'/>形状可以是带半径的圆，或带宽高的矩形，这是积类型之和。<bookmark mark='b'/>在前面写明的逻辑假设下，命题即类型字典把这些构造子解释为选择和序对。<bookmark mark='c'/>模式匹配检查构造子。穷尽性检查可以报告遗漏，但保证受语言设置、通配符和守卫影响。已有通配分支处理三角形时，新增三角形不一定要求每个匹配都修改。嵌套模式的分析，也不只是数构造子名字。<bookmark mark='d'/>option 把缺失变成显式选择。遵守接口时，它能排除未处理的空指针解引用，但提取值仍可能需要处理空分支。<bookmark mark='e'/>让非法状态不可表达，是有用的设计目标。类型可以编码选定不变量，不会自动覆盖应用所需的所有性质。

c4493698e051.en: Subtyping specifies which replacements preserve an interface's guarantees. <bookmark mark='a'/> A value of subtype S can be used where a T is expected under the language's subtype rules. A Dog can supply an Animal interface. <bookmark mark='b'/> For ordinary function subtyping, the replacement accepts at least the promised inputs and returns a sufficiently specific result. A function that can handle every Animal can serve a caller that supplies only Dogs. <bookmark mark='c'/> Results are covariant; arguments are contravariant. The arrows in the rule point in opposite directions for that reason. <bookmark mark='d'/> An unchecked mutable array both produces and consumes elements. Allowing Dog arrays to be used as writable Animal arrays would let a caller insert a Cat. Invariance prevents that substitution. Read-only views or runtime store checks permit other designs, with different contracts and costs.
c4493698e051.zh: 子类型规定哪些替换能够保留接口保证。<bookmark mark='a'/>按照语言的子类型规则，需要 T 的位置可以使用子类型 S 的值。例如 Dog 可以提供 Animal 接口。<bookmark mark='b'/>普通函数子类型中，替代函数至少能接受承诺的输入，并返回足够具体的结果。能处理所有 Animal 的函数，可以服务只会传入 Dog 的调用者。<bookmark mark='c'/>结果协变，参数逆变，规则中两个方向相反的箭头正是这个原因。<bookmark mark='d'/>不带检查的可变数组既产生元素，也接收元素。如果 Dog 数组能够当作可写 Animal 数组，调用者就能插入 Cat。不变性阻止这种替换。只读视图或运行时存储检查，可以支持其他设计，但契约和代价不同。

c6d6a95dd5ad.en: This recorded TypeScript example shows an intentional soundness tradeoff. <bookmark mark='a'/> The Dog array is assigned to an Animal-array variable. A Cat is pushed through that alias, and the original Dog-array expression later calls bark on the new element. <bookmark mark='b'/> The recorded compiler accepts it with exactly the displayed strict flag. Strict is a bundle of checks, not every possible checking option; additional indexed-access checks can report other concerns. <bookmark mark='c'/> Running the emitted JavaScript with the recorded Node version raises a TypeError because bark is not a function. The types were erased and supplied no runtime store barrier. <bookmark mark='d'/> Java's covariant reference arrays use a different contract: a runtime component-type check can reject an incompatible store. Compare the static rules and runtime checks together. Useful typing tools can deliberately offer less than the no-stuck-state theorem of a sound calculus.
c6d6a95dd5ad.zh: 记录中的 TypeScript 例子展示了有意选择的可靠性权衡。<bookmark mark='a'/>Dog 数组被赋给 Animal 数组变量，通过这个别名插入 Cat，随后原来的 Dog 数组表达式，对新元素调用 bark。<bookmark mark='b'/>记录的编译器使用屏幕上明确的 strict 选项时接受它。strict 是一组检查，并不包括所有可选检查；额外的索引访问检查可能报告其他问题。<bookmark mark='c'/>记录的 Node 版本运行生成的 JavaScript 时抛出类型错误，因为 bark 不是函数。类型已经擦除，没有提供运行时存储屏障。<bookmark mark='d'/>Java 协变的引用数组采用另一种契约：运行时按数组组件类型检查，能拒绝不相容的存储。静态规则与运行时检查必须一起比较。有用的定型工具，可以有意提供弱于可靠演算不出现卡住状态定理的保证。

487d80a2d867.en: Gradual typing studies how precise and imprecise type information can coexist. <bookmark mark='a'/> A gradual unknown type is related to other types by a consistency relation, with checks determined by the chosen semantics. TypeScript's any, its unknown type and Python's optional type hints make different choices; these mechanisms should not all be treated as one sound cast calculus. <bookmark mark='b'/> In the displayed TypeScript program, any allows forty-two to pass to a string-typed parameter. Erasure leaves ordinary JavaScript execution, and the result printed here is NaN. No runtime string contract was inserted. <bookmark mark='c'/> Sound gradual systems can insert boundary checks and higher-order wrappers. A 2016 Typed Racket study measured very large slowdowns for some partially typed configurations. That is a historical workload result, not a bound for every current implementation. Coercion composition and other techniques improve particular costs. The research exercise asks for a stated semantics and baseline before discussing guarantees.
487d80a2d867.zh: 渐进类型研究精确与不精确的类型信息如何共存。<bookmark mark='a'/>渐进未知类型通过一致性关系与其他类型联系，检查由选定语义规定。TypeScript 的 any、它的 unknown 类型，以及 Python 的可选类型提示，选择并不相同，不能全当作同一个可靠强制演算。<bookmark mark='b'/>屏幕中的 TypeScript 程序，用 any 让四十二通过字符串类型参数。擦除之后执行普通 JavaScript，本例打印 NaN，并没有插入运行时字符串契约。<bookmark mark='c'/>可靠的渐进系统可以插入边界检查和高阶包装。二零一六年的 Typed Racket 研究，在一些部分定型配置中测得很大减速。这是历史工作负载结果，不是所有当前实现的界限。强制组合及其他技术能改善某些代价。研究习题要求先明确语义和比较基线，再讨论保证。

f87ec1d4480a.en: Chapter fifteen. Frontier: the edges of type theory.
f87ec1d4480a.zh: 第十五章。前沿：类型论的边缘。

06e55fef02ab.en: Worst-case inference complexity and a measured workload answer different questions. <bookmark mark='a'/> We repeat the Job's eleven definitions in up to thirty-two copies, giving three hundred and fifty-two definitions. The graph shows recorded host times for this synthetic family. Unification-call counts grow exactly with the copy count; elapsed times also include implementation and scheduling effects and need not form a straight line. <bookmark mark='b'/> Shared type graphs avoid expanding repeated subtypes in the nested-let example. Complexity analyses parameterize more than source size, including type-scheme size and let structure; bounded nesting alone is not a complete universal linear-time guarantee. McAllester's 2003 work is one source for that analysis. <bookmark mark='c'/> To investigate an implementation, state the family and representation, measure work as well as wall time, and vary the parameters. A small favorable graph cannot establish how every real program behaves.
06e55fef02ab.zh: 最坏情形复杂度与实测工作负载，回答的是不同问题。<bookmark mark='a'/>我们把任务的十一个定义最多复制三十二份，得到三百五十二个定义。图中是这个合成函数族记录的主机耗时。合一调用次数与副本数严格成正比；实际耗时还受实现和调度影响，不必是一条直线。<bookmark mark='b'/>共享类型图让嵌套 let 例子避免展开重复子类型。复杂度分析除了源规模，还考虑类型方案大小和 let 结构等参数；只限制嵌套深度，不是普遍线性时间保证的完整条件。麦卡莱斯特二零零三年的工作是这类分析的来源之一。<bookmark mark='c'/>研究一个实现时，要说明程序族和表示，同时测量工作量与墙钟时间，并改变相关参数。一张有利的小图，不能建立所有真实程序的性能结论。

d2ddac8c770e.en: Refinement types attach logical predicates to values. <bookmark mark='a'/> In the displayed interface, get receives an array and an index satisfying zero less than or equal to i, and i less than the array length. The caller must establish that condition. <bookmark mark='b'/> Type checking generates verification conditions for a selected logic. An SMT solver may prove them, find a countermodel, or return unknown or a timeout. Solver failure to prove a condition does not by itself prove the program wrong. <bookmark mark='c'/> LiquidHaskell, F star and Dafny combine types, specifications and automated proof in different ways. Their verified properties depend on the stated specifications, supported theories and trust boundaries. <bookmark mark='d'/> The engineering challenge is to choose useful predicates and automation while keeping proof obligations understandable. Refinements can automate some proofs; they do not remove the need to define or justify the property.
d2ddac8c770e.zh: 精化类型给值附加逻辑谓词。<bookmark mark='a'/>屏幕接口中的 get 接受数组，以及满足零不大于 i、i 小于数组长度的索引。调用者必须建立这个条件。<bookmark mark='b'/>类型检查为选定逻辑生成验证条件。SMT 求解器可能证明、找出反模型，也可能返回未知或超时。没能证明一个条件，本身不表示程序一定错误。<bookmark mark='c'/>LiquidHaskell、F star 和 Dafny 以不同方式结合类型、规格与自动证明。验证的性质取决于写明的规格、支持的理论和信任边界。<bookmark mark='d'/>工程挑战是选择有用的谓词和自动化，同时让证明义务容易理解。精化可以自动完成某些证明，却不能省去定义、论证所需性质的工作。

3b65bbe3c033.en: Identity types give equality mathematical structure. <bookmark mark='a'/> A proof that a equals b is itself a term of an identity type, and proofs can have further equalities between them. <bookmark mark='b'/> Homotopy type theory interprets these witnesses as paths and higher paths. Voevodsky's univalent foundations helped develop this connection. <bookmark mark='c'/> Univalence relates equality of types to equivalence of types: the canonical map from type equalities to equivalences is itself an equivalence. This makes precise a way of transporting mathematical structure across equivalences. <bookmark mark='d'/> Adding an axiom without computation rules can leave closed data expressions without a canonical numeral normal form. That is a question about computation and canonicity in the extended theory, not a counterexample to the earlier theorem about our original simply typed calculus. <bookmark mark='e'/> Cubical type theories provide computational treatments of univalence. Their exact normalization and canonicity results depend on the chosen calculus. Implementations such as Cubical Agda turn these ideas into proof-assistant tools.
3b65bbe3c033.zh: 恒等类型让相等具有数学结构。<bookmark mark='a'/>a 等于 b 的证明，本身是恒等类型中的项；证明之间还可以有更高层的相等。<bookmark mark='b'/>同伦类型论把这些见证解释为路径及高阶路径。沃沃茨基的一价基础推动了这个联系。<bookmark mark='c'/>一价性把类型相等与类型等价联系起来：从类型相等到类型等价的典范映射，本身是等价。它精确表达了沿等价搬运数学结构的方式。<bookmark mark='d'/>加入没有计算规则的公理，可能让封闭的数据表达式无法归约成典范数值。这是在扩展理论中讨论计算与典范性，不是对前面原始简单类型演算定理的反例。<bookmark mark='e'/>立方类型论为一价性提供计算性处理。精确的正规化和典范性结果取决于选择的演算。Cubical Agda 一类实现把这些思想变成证明助手工具。

7f7ccfae4ba3.en: In a language with unrestricted effects, an ordinary int-to-int type does not list every action a function may perform. <bookmark mark='a'/> It might read a file, raise an exception or diverge. An effect system adds information about such behavior; its guarantees depend on which effects it tracks. <bookmark mark='b'/> An algebraic effect operation sends a request to a handler. The handler receives the operation's data and a captured delimited continuation, which it may resume according to the language's rules. The handler is not itself just the continuation. <bookmark mark='c'/> OCaml 5 introduced effect handlers in 2022, while languages such as Koka track effects in types. These systems differ in typing and continuation discipline. <bookmark mark='d'/> Usable interfaces, compositional reasoning and efficient implementations remain active design problems. Stating the operation and resumption rules lets us reason about a specific mechanism instead of treating all effects as interchangeable.
7f7ccfae4ba3.zh: 在允许不受限副作用的语言中，普通 int 到 int 类型不会列出函数可能做的所有事情。<bookmark mark='a'/>它可能读文件、抛异常或发散。效应系统增加这类行为信息；保证取决于它追踪哪些效应。<bookmark mark='b'/>代数效应操作向处理器发送请求。处理器收到操作数据，以及捕获的定界续延，并按语言规则决定如何恢复。处理器本身并不只是这个续延。<bookmark mark='c'/>OCaml 5 在二零二二年引入效应处理器，Koka 一类语言则在类型中追踪效应。这些系统的类型规则和续延使用约束不同。<bookmark mark='d'/>好用的接口、可组合推理与高效实现，仍是活跃设计问题。写明操作与恢复规则，才能分析具体机制，而不是把所有效应看成可以互换的东西。

d22b8c55ee87.en: Research questions become useful when their model is explicit. <bookmark mark='a'/> For gradual typing, choose a cast semantics, a cost model and a comparison baseline before asking for an overhead bound. Space-efficient coercion composition already addresses some wrapper-chain problems. <bookmark mark='b'/> For polymorphic inference, specify the language, rank convention, available annotations and whether the task is checking, typability or principal inference. Different restricted systems have different decidability results. <bookmark mark='c'/> For dependent types, study a concrete way to reduce proof burden while preserving the intended trusted core. <bookmark mark='d'/> For cubical computation, measure a stated proof workload and identify normalization or representation costs. <bookmark mark='e'/> The starred exercise starts with a small gradual cast calculus, reproduces a known space result, then asks for a precisely scoped extension. Reviewing known work comes before claiming an open problem.
d22b8c55ee87.zh: 明确模型，研究问题才有用。<bookmark mark='a'/>讨论渐进类型时，先选强制转换语义、代价模型和比较基线，再问开销上界。空间高效的强制组合，已经解决了一部分包装链问题。<bookmark mark='b'/>讨论多态推断时，要规定语言、秩的约定、可用标注，以及任务是检查、可定型性，还是主类型推断。不同受限系统的可判定性结果不同。<bookmark mark='c'/>讨论依赖类型时，研究一种具体的降低证明负担的办法，同时保留预期可信核心。<bookmark mark='d'/>讨论立方计算时，测量规定的证明工作负载，并定位正规化或表示开销。<bookmark mark='e'/>星号习题从小型渐进强制演算出发，先复现已知空间结果，再提出边界明确的扩展。声称一个问题开放之前，要先检查已有研究。

d3f1a2f5ca78.en: We built lambda terms and capture-avoiding substitution, then compared beta reduction with weak evaluation. Church encodings supplied data, and fixed points supplied recursion, with delayed branches needed for the strict factorial. Confluence made beta normal forms unique up to alpha equivalence, while simple types supported progress, preservation and strong normalization in the specified recursion-free calculus. Random runs checked implementations, not the general proofs. Hindley Milner inferred the Job's types; shared type graphs distinguished representation blowup from typability complexity. Pure System F supplied parametric free theorems, and unrestricted equality showed why the same printed type in our toy ML core does not automatically supply them. Propositions-as-types connected proof search with programs, with Kripke countermodels certifying the displayed intuitionistic non-theorems.
d3f1a2f5ca78.zh: 我们搭建了 λ 项和避免捕获的代换，再比较 β 归约与弱求值。丘奇编码提供数据，不动点提供递归；严格求值的阶乘还需要延迟分支。合流性让 β 范式在 α 等价意义下唯一；简单类型则在规定的无一般递归演算中，支持进展性、保持性与强正规化。随机运行检验实现，不代替一般证明。欣德利–米尔纳推断了任务类型，共享类型图帮助区分表示膨胀与可定型性复杂度。纯 System F 提供参数性免费定理；不受限相等操作说明，小型 ML 核心中相同的类型写法，不会自动提供同样定理。命题即类型把证明搜索与程序相连，克里普克反模型则证实了屏幕中直觉主义不可证公式的边界。

35a46a00f057.en: Where this comes back. Part 15 turns the lambda core into a real runtime, with environments, closures, continuations, a virtual machine and a garbage collector, and runs the Job on it for ledger row six. Part 25 proves the diagonal and recursion theorems that this part leaned on. Part 43 puts types on the boundaries between services. Part 54 proves programs correct in Lean and Rocq. Part 55 returns to Rust, and Part 58, in the research tier, asks what programs mean.
35a46a00f057.zh: 这些会在哪里再出现。第15部分把 λ-核心变成真正的运行时，有环境、闭包、续延、虚拟机和垃圾回收器，并在上面运行任务，得到账本的第六行。第25部分证明这一部分所依赖的对角线定理和递归定理。第43部分把类型放到服务之间的边界上。第54部分用 Lean 和 Rocq 证明程序正确。第55部分回到 Rust，而研究层的第58部分追问程序的含义是什么。

71b91d5a6baf.en: In practice, inference and annotations are combined differently by OCaml, Haskell, Rust, Swift and TypeScript. Generic parameters, bounds, interfaces and runtime operations determine what a polymorphic function may observe; a generic-looking signature alone does not establish a pure System F free theorem. Sum types and pattern matching help express application invariants, with exhaustiveness guarantees that depend on the language and compiler settings. Optional or gradual typing lets teams adopt checks incrementally, with different runtime contracts. Dependent proof assistants can verify chosen mathematical and software properties, relative to explicit specifications, kernels and trusted assumptions.
71b91d5a6baf.zh: 实际应用中，OCaml、Haskell、Rust、Swift 和 TypeScript，以不同方式结合推断与标注。泛型参数、约束、接口和运行时操作，共同决定多态函数能观察什么；看起来像泛型的签名，本身不能建立纯 System F 免费定理。和类型与模式匹配帮助表达应用不变量，但穷尽性保证取决于语言和编译设置。可选或渐进定型让团队逐步采用检查，同时选择不同运行时契约。依赖类型证明助手，可以在明确规格、内核和可信假设下，验证选定的数学与软件性质。

572256bb1913.en: The notes contain six worked exercises. Compare reduction orders with exact parentheses; measure a stated Church-subtraction strategy; prove the progress cases; and infer a principal type while respecting the environment. The build exercise starts with a precisely limited constructor-pattern language before extending exhaustiveness checking. The starred investigation reproduces known space-efficient gradual coercions, then asks for one explicit extension and cost claim. A research prompt begins with definitions and a literature check; the presence of a star does not make an already solved subproblem open.
572256bb1913.zh: 笔记有六道带解答的习题：用精确括号比较归约顺序；测量规定策略下的丘奇减法；证明进展性情形；以及在尊重类型环境的条件下推断主类型。动手题先规定受限制的构造子模式语言，再扩展穷尽性检查。星号研究题先复现已知的空间高效渐进强制，再提出一个明确扩展和代价主张。研究从定义和文献检查开始；标上星号，不会让已解决的子问题变成开放问题。

6c6025d30df1.en: Next time. The lambda core gets a runtime: closures and environments instead of substitution, continuations that turn the stack into data, a bytecode virtual machine, and a garbage collector kept correct by an invariant stated in three colours. Part 15, Runtimes.
6c6025d30df1.zh: 下一次。λ-核心有了运行时：用闭包和环境代替代换，用续延把栈变成数据，一台字节码虚拟机，以及一个由三种颜色表述的不变式保证正确的垃圾回收器。第15部分，运行时。

9bd24692775d.en: The books and papers this part follows are on screen and in the notes. Thank you for watching.
9bd24692775d.zh: 这一部分依据的书和论文都在屏幕上，也在笔记里。感谢观看。
